rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.e1: Now let's see what decides this ending. White tries to promote the pawn on e8; Black tries to stop it. For Black, a draw is enough: if the pawn does not promote, Black holds the draw. If the pawn runs alone, the black king steps in front of it, and the pawn is stuck. The king captures the way it moves: it goes to the square of a neighbouring piece and removes it. So the black king ends up taking the pawn. With only the two kings, neither side can win: it is a draw. That is why the pawn needs its king.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.e3: If the white king reaches certain squares, the pawn promotes, whatever the defence. These are the key squares. With the pawn on e3, the key squares are d5, e5 and f5: two ranks ahead of it, on the e-file and the files beside it.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.e3e4.1: With this move, Black finds a resource that holds the draw.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.e3e4.2: The black king goes to e6, in front of the pawn. With the pawn on e4, the key squares have moved up to d6, e6 and f6.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.f4e4.1: With this move, Black finds a resource that holds the draw.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.f4e4.2: The black king goes to e6: d5, e5 and f5 now neighbour it, and your king cannot step in.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.f4f3.1: With this move, Black finds a resource that holds the draw.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.f4f3.2: The black king takes e5, in the middle of the key squares, and shuts d5 and f5 to your king.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.f4g3.1: With this move, Black finds a resource that holds the draw.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.f4g3.2: The black king takes e5, in the middle of the key squares, and shuts d5 and f5 to your king.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.f4g4.1: With this move, Black finds a resource that holds the draw.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.f4g4.2: The black king takes e5, in the middle of the key squares, and shuts d5 and f5 to your king.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.f4g5.1: With this move, Black finds a resource that holds the draw.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.f4g5.2: The black king takes e5, in the middle of the key squares, and shuts d5 and f5 to your king.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.certo: Exactly! Your king has reached f5, a key square. The other two, d5 and e5, are next to the black king.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.l1: With the king on a key square, promotion is guaranteed, whatever the defence. What if Black went after the pawn?
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.l3: The black king goes to d5, towards the pawn. If your king climbed to f6 or g5, it would go to e4 and take the pawn.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.l4: So your king returns to f4 and defends the pawn: the black king cannot take it, because it would stand next to your king. The win is still guaranteed.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.l6: The black king can also drop back to e7, in front of the pawn: it is the toughest defence. Against this defence, bringing the pawn all the way to promotion takes a precise technique: it is the subject of the next chapter.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.l8: What if, in this position, White pushed the pawn instead of the king?
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.l9: With the pawn on e4, the key squares move up to d6, e6 and f6.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.l10: The black king goes to f7 and stands next to e6 and f6: your king cannot get in. It is the only move that holds the draw.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.l11: If your king goes to e5, the black king returns to e7, and d6, e6 and f6 stay shut. The pawn advanced too early: the key squares moved up, and the white king was left below them.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.l13: That is why the king goes in front first; the pawn advances afterwards.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.revela: The best is to take the king to f5, a key square: the other two, d5 and e5, are next to the black king.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.livre.fala: Keep playing with White and see how Black defends.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.fins.capturado: The black king captured the pawn: it is a draw.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.fins.afogado: The black king has no move and is not attacked: it is a draw.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.fins.repeticao: The black king always shut the way to the key squares.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.livre.volta: Let's go back to the starting position. Suggest another move or tap {verResposta}
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.p: White to move. Think and suggest a move, or tap {verResposta}
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.e1: Now let's think from Black's side. The pawn is on d3, and the key squares are c5, d5 and e5. The white king on f4 is already next to e5. Your king must stop it from entering a key square.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.l2: The white king goes to e4, next to d5 and e5, and keeps looking for a way in.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.l3: To keep the way shut in the moves to come, the black king will need a precise technique: it is the subject of the next chapter.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.l4: On d6, the black king stands next to all three key squares, and the white king cannot reach any of them.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.certo: Exactly! On d6, your king stands next to c5, d5 and e5: the white king cannot enter any of them.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.revela: The best is to take the king to d6, next to c5, d5 and e5: the white king cannot enter any of them.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.livre.fala: Keep playing with Black and see how White attacks.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.fins.afogado: The black king has no move and is not attacked: it is a draw.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.livre.volta: Let's go back to the starting position. Suggest another move or tap {verResposta}
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.p: Black to move. Think and suggest a move, or tap {verResposta}
rot.keySquares.demos.regra.1: Back to White's side. A rule for finding the key squares: with the pawn on the second, third or fourth rank, they lie two ranks ahead of it. It holds for pawns on the b to g files.
rot.keySquares.demos.regra.2: Here the pawn is on c2: the key squares are c4 and its neighbours b4 and d4.
rot.keySquares.demos.regra.3: The white king goes to d4, a key square: the win is guaranteed.
rot.keySquares.demos.regra.4: The black king goes to b4, towards the pawn. The pawn advances to c3, protected by the white king, and the win is still guaranteed.
rot.keySquares.demos.regra.torre: With a rook pawn (a or h file), the rule does not hold: even with the white king close, on b6, the black king in the a8 corner draws.
rot.keySquares.demos.regra.torre2: The pawn advances to a6, and the black king goes to b8: it stays next to the corner, and the white king cannot dislodge it.
rot.keySquares.demos.regra.torre3: The pawn reaches a7, but the black king stays in the corner: White cannot force promotion, and it is a draw.
rot.keySquares.demos.regra.preto: The rule also holds for the black pawn: its front is towards the 1st rank. With the pawn on d7, the key squares are c5, d5 and e5.
rot.keySquares.demos.regra.preto2: The white king heads for the pawn, but arrives too late: the black king enters e5, a key square of the d7 pawn, and Black wins.
rot.keySquares.demos.cedo.1: White has pushed the pawn to g4 before the king. Now let's think from Black's side.
rot.keySquares.demos.cedo.2: With the pawn on g4, the key squares move up to f6, g6 and h6, close to the black king.
rot.keySquares.demos.cedo.3: The black king takes f6, one of the key squares.
rot.keySquares.demos.cedo.4: The white king climbs to e3 toward the pawn; the black king goes to g5 and threatens it; the white king defends it from f3, but stays below f6, g6 and h6. The pawn advanced too early, and Black holds the draw.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.enunciado: Play White and find the best move.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.fim: Your king reached a key square before the black king: the win is guaranteed.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.c7b6.1: With this move, White finds a way to win.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.c7b6.2: From b6, your king is next to c5, but not to d5 or e5: the white king steps into e5, and the pawn will promote.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.c7b7.1: With this move, White finds a way to win.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.c7b7.2: From b7, your king is far from all three key squares: the white king steps into e5, and the pawn will promote.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.c7b8.1: With this move, White finds a way to win.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.c7b8.2: From b8, your king is far from all three key squares: the white king steps into e5, and the pawn will promote.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.c7c6.1: With this move, White finds a way to win.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.c7c6.2: From c6, your king is next to c5 and d5, but not to e5: the white king steps into it, and the pawn will promote.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.c7c8.1: With this move, White finds a way to win.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.c7c8.2: From c8, your king is far from all three key squares: the white king steps into e5, and the pawn will promote.

rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.peao.2: The black king goes to f6. With the pawn on g4, the key squares move up to f6, g6 and h6, and it already stands on one of them.

rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.lado.2: The black king goes to f6 and reaches the key squares first: your king can no longer get into them.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.d5.1: Your king goes to d5, far from the pawn and the key squares.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.d5.2: The black king goes to f6 and reaches the key squares first: your king can no longer get into them.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.f4.1: Your king climbs to f4, but still below the key squares.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.f4.2: The black king goes to f6 and shuts f5 and g5; if your king heads for h5, it goes to g6 and shuts that one too.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.e5.1: Your king climbs to e5, beside the key squares, but outside them.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.e5.2: The black king goes to g6 and stands next to f5, g5 and h5: your king cannot enter any of them.
rot.keySquares.pratica.defesa.enunciado: Play as Black and find the best move.
rot.keySquares.pratica.defesa.fim: On c6 your king stands next to b5, c5 and d5: the white king cannot enter any of them.
rot.keySquares.pratica.defesa.err.d6: On d6 your king is not next to b5: the white king steps into it, and the pawn will promote.
rot.keySquares.pratica.defesa.err.e6: On e6 your king is not next to b5 or c5: the white king steps into b5, and the pawn will promote.
rot.keySquares.pratica.defesa.err.c7: On c7 your king is far from b5, c5 and d5: the white king steps into b5, and the pawn will promote.
rot.keySquares.pratica.defesa.err.recua: Your king retreats and moves away from the key squares: the white king steps into b5, and the pawn will promote.
rot.keySquares.pratica.defesa.err.lado: Your king steps sideways, away from the key squares: the white king steps into b5, and the pawn will promote.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.l1: The white king will look for a way in; watch how your king answers.
